sloka: एवं ब्रुवन्त्यां सीतायां लक्ष्मणो दीनचेतनः ।शिरसा ऽ ऽवन्द्य धरणीं व्याहर्तुं न शशाक ह ।। ७.४८.१९ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ bruvantyāṁ sītāyāṁ lakṣmaṇo dīnacetanaḥ ।śirasā ' 'vandya dharaṇīṁ vyāhartuṁ na śaśāka ha ।। 7.48.19 ॥

translations.english: While Sita was speaking thus, Lakshmana, with a distressed mind, bowed his head to the earth and was unable to utter a word.
